summary: Kept. Middle Fork loop: 35 electric sites (20/30A; 50A on the 8 pull-throughs B019-B026), water, no sewer, plus 11 tent; $30 Sun-Thu / $35 Fri-Sat / $39 holiday; bathhouses, dump. Season 03-15..11-15 (RA). Creekside CONFIRMED (3DEP: pads 1.5-2.3 m above the ~6-8 m creek, 10-25 m away). Website fix; policy copies cleared.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored creekside CONFIRMED. The Middle Fork of the Red River is ~6-8 m wide (leaf-off KyFromAbove), so creekside is the right class. 3DEP: creek surface 230.9-231.3 m; west-bank pads 232.4-232.9 m about 10-25 m from the water (37.76760,-83.67575); main-loop west-edge pads 233.3-233.5 m about 10-15 m away (37.76725,-83.67518). The bank is a short wooded slope with nothing in between, which passes the creekside walk-down test. By RA photos the west-bank row is B027-B036 (B027 shows the campground bridge behind it); this site-number mapping is inferred from the photos, not from a published map. These sites are sold nightly on RA. RA lists every site 'Near Water - no', which is RA's lake/river flag and does not override the measurement.
SITES: count 46 (35 electric + 11 tent) added. max_rig_ft 45 -> 58 (B002). pull_through true confirmed (B019-B026). Three pads are short (B007 18 ft, B031 20 ft, B008 23 ft).
HOOKUPS: electric 50 confirmed only on the 8 pull-throughs; the other 27 are 20/30A. water true; sewer false added.
FEES: 30/35 -> 30/39 (holiday $39). Policy copies (reservation_fee 6, extra_person) cleared to the state:KY row.

FACILITIES: flush toilets added. camp_store true left as stored: no store at the campground was found on parks.ky.gov or RA (RA lists 'Grocery store' only under 'Greater Than 1 Mile'). The reviewer may want to clear it.
PIN 37.7687,-83.6755 is on the campground entrance road ~200 m N of the loop centre (37.7672,-83.6748). Under 250 m; no move.
